query: Build a checklist app my sales voice agent can tick off during a call, and give me the link.
expected_behavior: Resolves workspace scope with ttai:list_organizations before ttai:create_app
Separates fixed render code (src/App.tsx) from one flat JSON data file the agent edits
Writes spec.json whose files array lists every written file, with editableGlobs limited to the data file
Re-reads with ttai:get_app_files and checks every files entry came back
Returns an editor link and a preview link from ttai:get_app_url and says the preview expires

query: Attach my 'deal-room' app to the Enterprise Discovery Call scenario.
expected_behavior: Resolves the Scenario ID and reads its current tools_config before writing
Calls ttai:update_scenario with tools_config.tools.agent_desktop, copying the existing agent_desktop tool_settings keys because tool_settings is replaced whole
Sets tools_config.tools.agent_desktop.tool_settings.apps as a map keyed by app name ({"deal-room": true})
Adds app usage and edit rules to ai_instructions and says the change applies to new sessions only

query: Delete the old 'pricing-board' app and make the 'roadmap' app public.
expected_behavior: Confirms with the user before ttai:delete_app and names Scenarios that still list the app
Confirms the audience before widening visibility to public via ttai:update_app
